title: Item:Elixir of Discovery
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{Top}}
These potions increase your chance of finding named items in chests.

Elixirs works in [[raid]]s.{{Ref| {{Forums| p=6091163 }}}}

The effect lasts for 6 hours. The timer pauses while in a public area or logged out.

Mysterious Remnant Boost are bound to account. 

The elixir's bonus is added to the chance of finding named items. If your normal chance of finding a named item is 10%, drinking a +5% elixir will result in a 15% chance. {{Ref|{{Forums|p=6091579}}}}

Elixir of Discovery doesn't stack. The highest chance of them applies to the player who consumed them at the same time.

Elixirs of Discovery can be acquired from {{Item|Improved Epic Otto's Irresistible Box}} and Gold [[Daily Dice]] and during occasional [[DDO Point]]s promotions.

== Developer quote ==
{{Quote|developer=Steelstar|date=02-20-2022|quote=   
To clarify: When you open a chest, an Elixir of Discovery makes it more likely (by the % listed on the Elixir's tooltip) that you get something from that chest's Named Item List. Most unique things that can drop from chests are part of that chest's Named Items List, with a few rare exceptions (such as ingredients that drop 100% of the time, etc).

The Cursed Blade of Jack Jibbers is part of the Named Item List for the chest it drops from. Having an Elixir of Discovery running does increase your chance of pulling it, because you're more likely to pull something from that chest's Named Item List on opening the chest when you have an Elixir of Discovery running.

Elixirs of Discovery do not adjust odds of any given item within the Named Item List. There are a few other items in that chest's Named Item List, and those are more likely to appear when pulling from the Named Item List than the Cursed Blade of Jack Jibbers.

There is nothing unique about the way the Cursed Blade of Jack Jibbers is dropped other than its lower-than-average drop rate.
}}

== Notes ==
* Elixirs of Discovery were added as [[Daily Dice]] reward options with [[Update 38 Patch 1#Daily Dice|Update 38 Patch 1]].  
* They are exclusive to Gold Daily Dice and cannot normally be directly purchased from the DDO Store.
** But available as a bonus item when buying DDO points during Black Friday 2021.  
** Two greater elixirs are included in [[Improved Epic Otto's Irresistible Box]] (introduced in [[Update 41]])
** Existing characters on the Wayfinder server received a couple as compensation after a rollback with dataloss.
** [[VIP]]s receive a coupon for one when they purchase the [[Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh]] in the DDO Market.
** Update 70: Lesser, Greater, and Sovereign  Discovery Elixirs has been extended from 1 hour to 6 hours. Saltmarsh VIP Discovery Elixirs remain 3 hours and VIP Loyalty Reward Discovery elixirs remain 12 hours. This applies to already existing potions as well.
